title: Scholarship Application Information Sheet
subtitle: Capture award cycle, eligibility source, application evidence, and review rubric; confirm conflict disclosure and award notice.
description: Scholarship Application records award cycle, eligibility source, application evidence, review rubric, conflict disclosure, and award notice. Scholarship Application evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this scholarship application controlled information handoff when staff must document award cycle and eligibility source. Reconcile application evidence, review rubric, conflict disclosure, and award notice before the scholarship application handoff. Use the program rules, eligibility documents, transcript or work evidence, rubric scores, reviewer conflict statement, award ledger, decision notice, and acceptance receipt. Ask the assigned scholarship application reviewer to confirm award cycle against the organization's policy.
